highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.1 corrects malformed native text cleanup and clipped render-pass stencil checks.

bullets.detail: Fixes native allocator destruction order when corrupt serialized Slug data is rejected, avoiding use-after-free and invalid frees.
Checks clipped render-pass bounds against the cleared stencil area.

v4.150.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.1 corrects native text-resource cleanup and clipped render-pass stencil checks.
